title: Resident Evil 4 (Nintendo Switch, update 1.0.2) - The Mercenaries [RAM map PENDING live measurement]
notes: SCAFFOLD 2026-11-04. The RAM map is NOT measured yet. RE4 Switch is a port of the 2007 HD / PS2 / PC build (biohazard 4), NOT MT Framework, so it does NOT share re5_switch / re6_switch's sMain / sPlayer / cGameSys layout. Its layout is the RE4 engine's (pG global work area, the cEm / EmMgr enemy table, the title.cpp task with its TW menu work area), closest to the GameCube build in gbox.re4_merc_bot / gbox.re4_menus (G4BE08-ram.json). ARM64, little-endian, ASLR: every address is main's load base plus a fixed offset; the driver (gbox.mercs.titles.re4_switch) reads them, so this map holds no absolute fields.

Renders on Eden only on the GB10 (switch_linux_emulator=eden; Citron broken there - memory gbox-switch-render-fix-2026-11-03). NCE: a guest address is the host address, so /proc/<pid>/mem reads it directly. The guest RAM layout is the GAME's, so addresses measured on any Eden host apply to the lilspark MercMode rotation.

LIVE SCAN PLAN: docs/research/re4-switch-ram.md. Measure, in this order: (1) main's 64-byte read-only signature + its offset (module_base) to pin the build id; (2) the pG global work area (room u16, Leon's health s16) - GameCube pG+0x4FA8 room / +0x4FB0 hp are the starting hypotheses; (3) Leon's object pointer and his pos (3*f32) / facing (f32) - GC player+0x94 / +0xA4; (4) the EmMgr enemy table (base / count / stride) and per-enemy pos / health (GC enemy+0x94 / +0x320); (5) the Mercenaries game struct: countdown clock (frames), combo, kills, score, phase; (6) the title.cpp task's TW work area and the menu cursors (routine 5 main menu, 6 extra games -> The Mercenaries -> Select Player 0..4 -> Select Stage 0..3 -> routine 7 starting) - GC TW+0x28 / +0x54 / +0x55 / +0x56. Verify every write by reading it back live.

Characters (Select Player, left to right): Leon, Ada, Krauser, HUNK, Wesker. Stages (Select Stage, 2x2 grid): Village, Castle, Base, Waterworld. The Mercenaries is a separate mode from the story; a room 0x04RR is a Mercenaries stage, any other room is the story (the bot never plays it).

mercs.ready stays false until the scan fills gbox.mercs.titles.re4_switch's constants and a Mercenaries round is reached under autoplay (gameplay frame + RAM read). While false, MercMode keeps RE4 out of the rotation (gbox.mercs_bot.title_engine).
